name: Whip Pan
description: A fast camera pan that streaks both clips with motion blur, the second arriving from the opposite side. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: direction
params.description: Direction in which the clips move (x right, y up)

params.name: blur
params.description: Length of the motion blur at full speed
